items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1973-09-07
items.q: And then we had this guy, Charles Levere. And we had Zooty, and then we had Bill and Huey Long, Huey Long guitar player, Bill was a bass player.

ctx.x: Yeah, Joe. And then we had this guy, Charles Levere. And we had Zooty, and then we had Bill and Huey Long, Huey Long guitar player, Bill was a bass player. He committed suicide, so to say, about a year or so ago. Some people say he didn't, some say he's a nice bass player. Anyhow, we did the recording. And I heard him recently, and it did sound bad. But I understand she's living in New York State now. But we never did receive any money from that. Never did.
That would have been a good time to get some money. Yeah. 1935. Yeah.
